body:
<!-- plain-summary -->
This lets an operator pick, through configuration, whether Wyrd keeps its metadata in the simple built-in database (for development) or the distributed cluster (for production), and makes the local path run reliably under the same async runtime the cluster uses. It matters because it's the point where the whole backend swap actually happens, done as a small wiring change in one place rather than a rewrite, while keeping retries from becoming a slowdown over the network.

**Scope:** the **composition change** the milestone exists to demonstrate, confined to the one crate ADR-0016 designates for wiring concretes. The entire production redb coupling lives in `crates/server/src/cli.rs` and is three concrete things: (1) **~8 sites construct/type `RedbMetadataStore` concretely** — parameterize the `cli.rs` metadata helpers over `M: MetadataStore` and add the **redb | tikv** selector by config (the selection mechanism does not exist today — no feature flag/config key/enum dispatch — so "one-line switch" is overstated); (2) **async-runtime wiring** — redb's methods are async-signature but sync-bodied and driven by `pollster::block_on`; a `tokio`-bound TiKV client can't run there, so move the local paths onto the `tokio` runtime the cluster paths already use (confined to `cli.rs`; trait is already async, no signatures ripple into `core`/`custodian`); (3) **`alloc_inode`'s unbounded retry-on-`Conflict` spin** (`cli.rs:352-368`) — harmless over sub-µs local redb, a latency footgun over per-iteration network round-trips on TiKV → give it **bounded retries with backoff**. redb stays the dev/single-binary default (ADR-0014).

**Definition of done**
- [ ] `server` runs identically on redb (dev) and TiKV (prod), selected by config
- [ ] the diff outside `metadata-tikv` is confined to `server`; `core`/`custodian` byte-for-byte untouched; `traits` unchanged
- [ ] local paths run on `tokio`; `alloc_inode` has bounded retries with backoff
- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` green on **both** backends

**Needs:** M4.2 (M4.3 helpful). **Refs:** proposal 0007 §"Composition, not refactor", §"Crate touch-points", §"Suggested PR sequence" (4); ADR-0014, ADR-0016. Branch `feat/m4.4-server-backend-selection`, commit `feat(server): … (M4.4, #<issue>)`.

milestone.title: M4 — Production metadata backend
milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0015 (supersedes 0007; acceptance PR #417); tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.

title: M4.4 — backend selection in server (the composition change: M: MetadataStore + redb|tikv selector + tokio + alloc_inode backoff)
